description: Harder evaluation set for the same PromoStandards specifications. Paraphrased questions avoid the specs' field and function names, the way a user would ask. Cross-document questions need passages from more than one spec (match: all) or accept any spec that states a shared rule (match: any).

questions.question: How can I tell from a supplier's stock feed that an item is made to order rather than kept on the shelf?
If a supplier reports stock in dozens, which code would they use for the unit?
How does an invoice show that it is really a refund owed to us rather than a bill?
Is there a way to find out which invoices a supplier has cancelled?
Can I look up shipments when all I know is the day they went out?
When setting up a product's options, how are choices that can't be combined with each other handled?
How would I know which cancer or birth-defect warnings a product needs for sale in California?
Can the supplier's media service give me product videos, or only pictures?
How do I ask for next-day delivery on an order I send to a supplier?
How can I check whether a supplier still allows a product to be sold?
What freight classification details can I get for a product?
I sent an order and got back both a transaction number and some error messages. Did the order go through?
When an order includes setup or decoration charges, where do the charge identifiers come from, and which function lists the available charges?
An order references a decoration by its id. Which service defines those decorations, and how do I find out what colours a decoration can use?
Across these services, which error code numbers are set aside for standard errors shared by all of them?
What severity levels can a service message have?

out_of_scope.question: Which shipping carrier is cheapest for sending promotional products to Canada?
What is the minimum order quantity for a branded water bottle?
